The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see we're in the Settings app, and I can see "Network & internet" option which mentions "Mobile, Wi‑Fi, hotspot". This is where I need to go to turn on WiFi.

Looking at the current screen, I can see:
- Settings title at the top
- Search settings option
- Network & internet option (this is what I need to tap)
- Connected devices
- Apps
- Notifications
- Battery
- Storage

I need to tap on "Network & internet" to access WiFi settings.
